shared_elements: upright carved stone slab / freestanding monolith set in the ground
relief carving of animal or creature forms in profile
horizontal band or register dividing the surface
rubble/stone base at the foot of the monument
justification: Both show a tall, upright carved stone slab standing on rubble, with imagery organised in stacked registers and creature forms rendered in profile relief, which is the clearest correspondence. But A is extremely spare and shallow, with isolated, widely spaced animal outlines on a plain ground, whereas B is a densely packed, deeply undercut, near-sculptural composition dominated by a single frontal human figure in elaborate costume — the density, subject emphasis and depth of carving are entirely different.
